caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a repeating geometric pattern composed of squares divided diagonally into triangles, and each square containing additional shapes such as petal-like ovals and kite-shaped forms. The color palette is primarily green, pink, and red, with green and pink alternating across the triangles and ovals, and red forming prominent central triangles within each square. The quilt is bordered on three visible sides by a scalloped edge, each scallop filled with alternating green and brown or pink segments patterned with dots or lines. The quilt’s interior pattern is made up of pieced and colored sections, with many small, regularly spaced diagonal lines providing the appearance of stitched quilting throughout. The composition is symmetrical, with each square rotated as part of the overall repeating design. The background of the drawing is a plain, light tan or cream color, and the quilt appears to be viewed from above, filling most of the frame.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
